column1: # Stage S4 X4a — the S4a switch: every consumer of a moved module imports the new crate directly, and the legacy re-export shims go.
# One row per module-prefix line of the S4a shim ledger, split per scope. Item-path imports (single
# items, grouped `use` trees, the console macros, the frame ids, the layout facade) cannot be prefix
# rows and are rewritten by hand.
# world_file_formats: the map engine's on-disk formats
# render_primitives: the text module and the GPU-free draw modules
# geometry_primitives: the 2D segment helpers and the rigid transform
# map_coordinates: chunk indexing, the grid reference and JavaScript rounding
# camera_math: gl-matrix's mat4 port and the two cameras
